Name: Jinu in the Casino (KPop Demon Hunters)
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod replaces the shady "Statue of Endless Fortune" seller in Qi's Club with Jinu.
The corner guy doesn't do or talk much, anyway. So why not bring in someone with a little more presence?

Jinu will still sell the stuff, but now he’s got a few other things to talk about. Some lighthearted, some haunted.

[b][size=6]L[/size][size=5]atest Update
[/size][/b]Added config for Nyapu-style portraits! (big thank you to AhCuteArt for the glow up!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vejy54r.png[/img]

[/list][color=#9fc5e8][b][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/b][/color][size=5]
